[ERROR LIST]

- Line 118: `resizeGradientLayers(in:to:)` only resizes immediate `CAGradientLayer` children of the overlay’s root layer. If a gradient is later placed inside a nested layer or view, it will retain a stale size after the overlay frame changes.

- Line 203: The liquid-glass view sets `clipsToBounds = true`, then later sets `effectView.layer.masksToBounds = false`. These properties control the same underlying clipping behavior, so the final setting disables clipping. Consequently, the rounded clipping declared just above is not reliably preserved for the blur/content layers.

- Line 203: Disabling `masksToBounds` to show the shadow allows the one-point `highlight` sublayer and other layer contents to draw outside the rounded bounds when applicable. A separate shadow-host view and clipped content view are required if both correct clipping and an external shadow are intended.[1]

- Line 211: The highlight layer added in `buildLiquidGlassView` is never tracked or resized. When an `"lg"` overlay changes width, `resizeGradientLayers(in:to:)` does not resize this plain `CALayer`, so the highlight remains at its original width.

- Line 264: `view.clipsToBounds = true` is followed by `view.layer.masksToBounds = false` on line 272. The latter overrides the former at the layer level, so the bubble’s gradient is not clipped to its rounded corners.

- Line 272: Disabling `masksToBounds` to display the bubble shadow means the gradient and background are not reliably masked to the rounded geometry. This produces visually incorrect square/unclipped content for a rounded bubble. Correct rounded clipping plus an external shadow requires separate layers/views.[1]

- Line 293: `buildInputBarView` applies `cornerRadius` but does not set `clipsToBounds`. If this wrapper later receives visible content or sublayers, its corner radius does not enforce rounded clipping.

- Line 333: `buildGenericView` applies `cornerRadius` but does not set `clipsToBounds`. Therefore generic overlays with a background color may show rounded background/border behavior, but any future subview or sublayer content can extend outside the intended rounded boundary.

- Line 346: `updateForTraitCollection(_:)` updates only records whose `elementType` is `"lg"`. `"hcard"` records also use `UIVisualEffectView` with a dark blur material, but their blur effect is never updated on an interface-style change.

- Line 350: On a switch to light appearance, every `"lg"` overlay is changed to `.systemUltraThinMaterialLight`, even if its original visual specification deliberately required the dark material. The method changes rendering semantics rather than merely refreshing a dynamic effect.

[END OF LIST]

that’s all.
